headword: {太白|たいはく}ごま{油|あぶら}

definitions.gloss: unroasted sesame oil; pale sesame oil
definitions.explanation: Sesame oil pressed from raw (unroasted) sesame seeds. Pale and almost colorless, with a mild flavor — unlike the dark, fragrant roasted-sesame oil used as a finishing seasoning.

examples.japanese: {太白|たいはく}ごま{油|あぶら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{揚|あ}げる→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧。
⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{太白|たいはく}ごま{油|あぶら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: Unroasted sesame oil goes well with tempura.

examples.japanese: {太白|たいはく}ごま{油|あぶら}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{控|ひか}えめ→控えめ：17234_hikaeme⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{邪魔|じゃま}しない→邪魔する：05651_jamasuru⟧。
examples.english: Since unroasted sesame oil has a mild aroma, it doesn't interfere with the flavor of the ingredients.

notes:
{太白|たいはく} literally means "very white," referring to the pale color. Favored for deep-frying tempura and for baking, where the strong aroma of roasted sesame oil would be unwanted.
